g.title: v2_control_flow
g.text: VT6L agent v2: one instruction as a state machine (LOOK, PLAN, DISPATCH, REVIEW, DECIDE, ASK, FINISH), all paths to success or failure

g.title: cluster_skill
g.text: Pick / place skill (pick_place.py, sensors + collision-checked motion, no Gemma)

g.title: look
g.text: table camera -> YOLO masks -> depth -> world ids

g.title: plan
g.text: Gemma, thinking on; system prompt describes the workers
camera image + objects and places in words -> '<worker>: <plain sentence>' lines + memory

g.title: p_look
g.text: arm moved since the last look

g.title: m_read
g.text: the only place with internal numbers:
numbered image + numbered objects, places, held object ->
pick #n | place <rel> #n or R | pick + place | home | cannot

g.title: decide
g.text: request + the table NOW + its memory +
plan left + latest reports + budget left
-> decision + memory rewritten in plain words

g.title: p_find
g.text: camera image + objects and places in words

g.title: m_vals
g.text: empty gripper for a pick, held object for a place

g.title: s_obs
g.text: fresh look reused, or park out of view
if the object was hidden, then look

g.title: v_chk
g.text: held: fingers -> wrist depth -> table camera
placed: measured position vs target / place outline

g.title: s_loc
g.text: object / target measured in this view?

g.title: s_vp
g.text: park, look, compare to plan (10 mm, 5 mm, 5 deg);
not outlined by the detector: depth at the planned spot
